body:
The Living chat gave the sheep a neck hidden in the wool and the cow a round neck (31 Oct).
- Sheep: head down to the grass, bites, chews, looks round.
- Flock: 3 sheep + lamb graze at different times.
- Cow: same graze, rounder neck.

comments.text:
Done: sheep, flock and cow graze; muzzles reach the grass, feet stay down.
Check: sheep 8/10, flock 7, cow 6 (its head is still a box shape).

short: Sheep and cow graze with their new necks. OK?
source: Model movements 31 Oct: gap check against the stage briefs
title: Sheep grazing; cow neck shape
